description: The kubernetes manager has no default file pattern, so images in plain manifests are invisible to Renovate unless the files are named here. Without this, spiffe-csi-driver and csi-node-driver-registrar went unupgraded for two years (FARN-225).

charts/**/templates/spiffe-csi-driver.yaml is listed explicitly rather than globbing the templates directory: the CSI DaemonSet hardcodes its two image tags, whereas the other templates build image refs out of Go template expressions that Renovate cannot parse.

packageRules.description: This repo's own image. Its version line is driven by hand and sequenced against the chart (see RELEASING.md), so Renovate must not bump it.

Not a real image. k8s/spire/deployment.yaml uses a ko build directive, "ko://github.com/spirl/spiffe-demo-app", which the kubernetes manager parses down to a bare "ko" package with no version. Nothing can be resolved from it, so disable it rather than let it accumulate lookup failures on the dependency dashboard.
Automerge updates that CI actually exercises and that cannot publish an artifact on merge.
Actions used only by the release workflows. CI never runs them, so a bad bump would surface mid-release. Review by hand.
A push to main touching charts/** publishes the chart via release.yml, and chart-releaser silently no-ops when Chart.yaml version is unchanged. Never automerge here.
